correctness.rationale: For K=JA−iγ|o><o|/2, imaginary-part energy identity forces each real eigenmode to vanish at hub; these modes reduce K and are Hermitian while all complementary eigenvalues have strictly negative imaginary parts, so the long-time norm equals a dark-projector diagonal. Dirichlet arm eigenfrequencies are reduced fractions p/q, with r_q shared arms; hub matching imposes one weighted condition b=(1/√m_i), giving dimension φ(q)(r_q−1). Diagonal projection of a site yields (2/m_i)sin²(πpd/q)(1−(m_iW_q)^(−1)); summing coprime p gives (φ(q)−c_q(d))/m_i times that parenthesis. Positivity yields survival zero iff every shared q divides d, equivalently lcm_j gcd(m_i,m_j) divides d. The sitewise and pairwise-coprime conclusions follow for B≥3, L_i≥1, J,γ>0. Fresh independent rational formula and full-adjacency eigenspace projector checks agree on five uneven spider profiles; sample (2,5,7) has D=3 and last arm alternating 1/7 and zero. Finite checks are corroboration, not all-arm proof.
